reason: The README clearly describes an agent request middleware plugin that detects image content and routes only those requests to a configured multimodal model while leaving other requests on the default model.

summaries.zh: 根据请求上下文中的图片内容，自动将需要视觉理解的智能体请求路由到配置的多模态模型。
summaries.en: Automatically routes agent requests containing image content to a configured multimodal model while leaving other requests on the default model.

capabilities: Detects image content in model request messages
Changes the selected provider and model for requests containing images
Routes requests to configured external multimodal model services
